description: a slim young prophet who sees every fate, a young man with light skin, long straight silver-white hair hanging straight down his back at rest, not flying, a youthful handsome clean-shaven face, no beard, eyes glowing gold, a small thin golden ring of light close behind the head, no wider than the shoulders, long robes of black and gold covered with small golden embroidered eyes, a large golden eye on the chest, a long black and gold cloak hanging behind from the shoulders, brown boots, no staff, no flying pages and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the ring of light to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same character seen from the side: young face, silver hair, ring of light, robes with the golden eyes, colours and drawing style; not the sitting pose and not the hands on the reins: he stands and walks
the character's look in detail: young face, silver hair, ring of light, robes with the golden eyes and colours; the hands empty, without the staff and the flying pages
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right, upright mid-step, not turned towards the viewer; copy it exactly
